title: Dynamic electricity tariff appraisal under trial-estimated and assumed demand response

creators.name: Jafari, Hesam
creators.affiliation: School of Industrial Engineering, Iran University of Science and Technology

creators.name: Sahebi, Hadi
creators.affiliation: School of Industrial Engineering, Iran University of Science and Technology

description:
Research software for evaluating dynamic electricity tariff schedules under trial-estimated and assumed household response. The workflows cover the Low Carbon London tariff calendar, constrained monthly planning and policy learning, and conditional gas-fleet impacts in ERCOT.

The corresponding archived inputs support regeneration of the London appraisal comparisons and the ERCOT operating outcomes in the accompanying paper. The 2023 fixed-tariff validation scenarios and the frozen 2024 assessment are identified separately.
